_comment: Type-check ONLY — the FIXTURE PACKAGE's components
Why this is a lane of its own, and not a line added to
tsconfig.scaffold.json: that config type-checks the SHIPPED scaffold,
which is published; this one checks a test fixture, which is not. Same
mechanism, different subject, and mixing them would make the published
package's gate depend on test content.
Why it exists at all: `check-scaffold` compiles project/.sdk/src/cmp/**
and nothing else, so a package-shaped component tree had NO compile lane
— exactly the gap §15 of docs/design/sdkgen-packages.md names. A fixture
package whose components do not compile would fail deep inside a
generation run, as a require error naming a path rather than a type
tm/ is excluded: a template tree is copied verbatim with placeholder
substitution, so its .ts files are template SOURCE, not modules — the
